description:
The filtered impact feed — news by megatrend/country/aspect/direction/news_type, across stocks,
    FX, crypto, COMMODITIES (metals/energy) and private cos. Use for 'negative tariff news on
    Semiconductors', 'macro news moving European stocks', 'copper / metals news', etc. Near-duplicate
    stories are MERGED by default (+`dup_count`); `collapse=false` for the raw feed. `limit` = how many
    (default 20, max 50); narrow the filters rather than paging deep. TIME-SCOPE with `from_`/`to` (ISO)
    or a `window` ('90d','qtd','ytd','1y'). To COMPARE periods, call once per period and compare the
    results. ⚠️ News starts 2026-01-01 — older ranges return nothing (no coverage, not 'no news').
    `megatrend` accepts a plain name/slug/concept ('foundry', 'AI chips') — resolved server-side to node id(s).

aspect.description: Impact CHANNEL filter (e.g. `demand`, `competition`, `tariff`, `monetary`). Omit → all channels.
aspect.title: Aspect

collapse.description: Merge near-duplicate stories (same article from many outlets) into one row + `dup_count`. Default ON; pass `false` for the raw un-deduped feed.
collapse.title: Collapse

country.description: Market filter — CSV of ISO-2 codes (e.g. `US` or `CN,TW,HK`). 🌍 If the question names a NATIONALITY or REGION ('European','Thai','Chinese','ASEAN'), put it HERE — never leave it inside a concept/`q`/`gics` field. Enumerate a region into its member ISO-2s yourself (Europe→GB,DE,FR,IT,ES,NL,CH,SE; ASEAN→TH,SG,MY,ID,PH,VN).
country.title: Country

detail.description: `compact` (default): per story title, date, publisher, types, impact_score, a short brief and the TOP-3 impacted entities (direction + relevance + one-line why) — fits the client's tool-output limit. `full`: every impacted entity with all its aspects (bigger; use with a small `limit`).
detail.title: Detail

direction.description: Filter by impact direction: `pos` | `neg` | `ambiguous`. Omit → all.
direction.title: Direction

format.description: `json` (default): structured rows. `text`: the same stories as plain readable lines (no JSON keys / quotes / nesting) — about half the size; prefer it when you only need to READ the news to answer.
format.title: Format

from_.description: Lower time bound, ISO date `YYYY-MM-DD`. ⚠️ Ava Advisor NEWS coverage starts 2026-01-01 (nothing before).
from_.title: From

limit.description: Max rows (default 20, hard cap 50). Keep SMALL + narrow the scope; page/refine rather than dump — heavily-covered assets have hundreds of articles.
limit.title: Limit

megatrend.description: A megatrend node — a name/slug (resolved for you, e.g. `foundry`) or an int node id. CSV for several.
megatrend.title: Megatrend

only_scored.description: Keep only articles carrying a judged per-entity impact. Omit → all gated articles.
only_scored.title: Only Scored

window.description: News-recency window: `7d`/`30d`/`90d`/`180d`/`1y` or `mtd`/`qtd`/`ytd`. Omit → a sensible default. (Price history is unaffected — this only scopes the NEWS lens.)
window.title: Window
